quests.title: Treasures Beneath the Vines

dialogue.t: Didn't you bring me here, little one? Keep moving!
Never mind, you better stay put...
I'm duped by it, again... Let me give you a rundown from the beginning.
For starters, you may not believe Seelie are somehow easily drawn to me.
Among the Seelie that came to follow me, I found one kind that is particularly keen on treasure-seeking.
I'm not good at naming. I'll just call them Treasure-Seeking Seelie.
They excel at treasure-seeking. With their help, I dug up a lot of treasures and made a profit with them.
But sometimes they suddenly tune out on me. I don't know if they're tired of the seeking, or just think I'm too boring...
Then I'd find a helper favored by the Seelie.
The helper takes Treasure-Seeking Seelie to locate the treasures, and I sell them for a fair price.
They say ruins and antiques are everywhere in Sumeru. So I came to look for my fortune.
And I attracted a bunch of Seelie here, of course. Some Treasure-Seeking Seelie brought me here.
But they ignored me again not long after I scooped up some dirt...
Eh? Why did it suddenly start to move? Could it be...
Traveler, are you interested in treasure-seeking with Seelie?
That won't be necessary. Just follow it and dig where it stops.
How's that sound? Just give it a try... If you scoop up some treasure, I'll only want the "Ancient Iron Coins" if there is any. The rest is all yours!
And say you do help me find some of those coins, I'll pay you for them at a fair price.

dialogue.sit: I could give it a go...

dialogue.t: That's the spirit! I like you!
Anyways, we are partners now!
Take this notebook. I recorded on it some hidden treasure sites I found before but haven't had a chance for a dig.
I'm counting on you then, Traveler. Come back and bring me the "Ancient Iron Coins" if you find any.
Didn't you bring me here, little one? Keep moving!
Never mind, you better stay put...
Traveler? It's been a while.
Are you still bumming around the world? I've heard many amazing stories about you. You're really phenomenal.
What troubles are you gonna fix this time in Sumeru?
Right, back to business, Traveler. How about another team-up action?
The land of Sumeru is strewn with treasures. Mora everywhere.
Seelie are drawn to me as usual. And the Treasure-Seeking Seelie we got so familiar with are among them too.
Same as before. You and the Seelie look for treasures, and I'll prepare your payment.
We'll surely rake it in as a team!
No. This time I'm looking for "Ancient Iron Coins," which are worth more.
It's not! The antique ones sell for more Mora.
So it's a deal then. Let's make a pile as a team like we used to!

quests.description: You run into a strange person near Sumeru City…
